name: GetLead
label: Get a lead
description: Retrieves a single lead from Salesforce by its ID using the Salesforce REST API.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: LeadId
fields.label: Lead ID
fields.description: The ID of the lead to retrieve

fields.name: LeadData
fields.label: Lead Data
fields.description: The retrieved Lead data as a JSON string.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
